description.value: The Fairmont Vancouver Airport is a luxury hotel physically integrated within Vancouver International Airport (YVR) in Richmond, BC, making it one of the few in-terminal airport hotels in Canada. Its location on Grant McConachie Way puts it at the heart of a major Pacific gateway and steps from the Canada Line rapid transit. For touring cyclists flying in or out of BC, it offers a premium on-site option at the region's busiest air hub.
